description: This file implements MessagePack encoding and decoding for Lua, providing functions for serializing Lua data types into MessagePack format and deserializing MessagePack data back into Lua types. It includes functions for handling various data types, buffer management, and Lua module initialization.

methods.name: memrevifle
methods.description: Reverses the byte order of a float or double in memory if the system is little endian.

methods.name: mp_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory for buffers using Lua's allocator function.

methods.name: mp_buf_new
methods.description: Creates a new message pack buffer.

methods.name: mp_buf_append
methods.description: Appends data to the message pack buffer, reallocating if necessary.

methods.name: mp_cur_init
methods.description: Initializes a cursor for parsing MessagePack data.

methods.name: mp_decode_to_lua_type
methods.description: Decodes a MessagePack object to a Lua type.

methods.name: mp_decode_to_lua_array
methods.description: Decodes a MessagePack array to a Lua table.

methods.name: mp_decode_to_lua_hash
methods.description: Decodes a MessagePack map to a Lua table.

methods.name: mp_pack
methods.description: Serializes multiple Lua arguments into MessagePack format.

methods.name: mp_unpack_full
methods.description: Unpacks MessagePack data into Lua objects, with optional limit and offset.

methods.name: mp_unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a single MessagePack object from input string.

methods.name: mp_unpack_one
methods.description: Unpacks one MessagePack object from input string at a specified offset.

methods.name: mp_unpack_limit
methods.description: Unpacks up to a limit of MessagePack objects from input string at a specified offset.

methods.name: mp_safe
methods.description: Wraps MessagePack functions with error handling, returning nil on error.

methods.name: luaopen_create
methods.description: Creates the MessagePack module table with functions and metadata.

methods.name: luaopen_cmsgpack
methods.description: Lua module entry point for cmsgpack, initializes the module.

methods.name: luaopen_cmsgpack_safe
methods.description: Lua module entry point for cmsgpack_safe, wraps functions with error handling.
